task: On target branch migration/svelte-go-live-candidate, implement one bounded V3 CPython 3.14 runtime-validation hardening pass. Start from the current #601 integration head and preserve the existing Review Lab/Product E2E authority split. The goal is not a new audit: make validation that claims to prove the V3 backend execute on the intended CPython 3.14 runtime. Keep Codex worker/orchestration infrastructure itself on its existing Python 3.12 bootstrap and do not change codex-laptop.yml or tests that intentionally enforce the worker bootstrap. Inspect all current #601 workflows and update V3 application-runtime validation consistently, including at minimum: normal backend unit/integration validation that covers the deployable API, backend coverage, Product E2E API backend for Chrome and Firefox, Review Lab backend, and release-image/runtime proof. Add explicit runtime identity evidence/assertions so these lanes cannot silently fall back to 3.12. Preserve genuinely legacy/tooling-only checks on 3.12 where they do not validate the V3 runtime, but make that distinction explicit rather than leaving mixed semantics. The V3 release dependency path must remain tied to apps/api/pyproject.toml + apps/api/uv.lock with pinned uv 0.11.33/frozen resolution; do not merely flip setup-python while testing a materially different dependency graph. Where test-only dependencies are needed, install them in a way that keeps the V3 runtime dependencies aligned with the frozen lock and update lock/config contracts if required. Strengthen the existing apps/api/Dockerfile.release CPython 3.14 proof so server startup exercises the real FastAPI lifespan instead of bypassing it with --lifespan off; provide only the disposable services/configuration required for a true startup/health proof and do not weaken production startup semantics. Run focused contract tests plus the relevant backend unit/integration/coverage and browser lanes as far as the worker environment allows. Do not redesign Review Lab scenarios, do not broaden Product E2E scope, do not touch production credentials/hosts, do not deploy, and do not perform database mutation outside disposable test services. Update documentation/contracts only where needed to state the final rule: V3 application validation runs on CPython 3.14; Codex worker infrastructure may remain 3.12. Use the governed trusted-push path to fast-forward the target branch only after tests pass. In the worker result, report the exact pushed SHA, every workflow/file changed, exact Python/uv versions actually exercised, whether frozen-lock install succeeded, whether real lifespan startup passed, and any remaining test that still runs V3 application code under 3.12 with a reason.
